title: VDBE unconditional goto and EXPLAIN parent-stack wrappers

scope.rationale: These source-shaped code-generation wrappers preserve unconditional jump operands and the addrExplain parent chain used to nest and pop EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN nodes.

dependencies.caller_closure: All three active wrapper functions are assigned; formatted Explain generation and consumers remain outside this unit.

inputs: INIT-state Vdbe and destination, or Parse with zero/valid addrExplain
outputs: OP_Goto with P1/P3 zero and exact P2 destination; current parent address; popped parent state
contracts.state_and_results: Goto returns appended address. Parent zero short-circuits without dereferencing pVdbe. Nonzero parent reads operation P2. Pop replaces addrExplain with that P2.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No callback or I/O; parser connection mutex is caller obligation.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Goto inherits sticky OOM behavior from AddOp3. Parent/pop perform no allocation.

representation_differences: The Parse pVdbe opaque pointer is aligned-cast to the exact source-layout Vdbe only after the zero-parent short circuit.

oracle.protocol: The shared symbolic worker appends a Goto, verifies exact operands/address, exercises the zero-parent short circuit, then reads and pops a nonzero parent through an operation P2. C and Zig compare the results in a 366-observation trace.
oracle.normalization: Opcode and every integer field are exact; no pointer values are compared.

assurance.oom: Goto dependency coverage exercises sticky and one-shot append OOM; parent/pop allocate nothing.
assurance.malformed_input: Source requires valid nonzero addrExplain; worker uses a packaged operation.
assurance.continuation: Resulting operation remains mutable and parent state remains available to subsequent code generation.
assurance.performance: One append wrapper or one indexed read preserves constant-time source shape.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact Parse, Vdbe, and Op state; parser Explain call sites remain handwritten.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Integrate parser Explain generation and consumers.

independent_review.notes: Requires parser integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Integrate source parser code generation with these wrappers.
